name: probability_currents
caption: Frobenius norm of J_ij = π_i T_ij − π_j T_ji with a 95% trajectory-bootstrap CI. Intervals that reach ~0 are consistent with equilibrium-like currents on this sample. Glimmer's larger norm is an underpowered 2-trajectory cell and is not a circulation claim.
alt_text: Frobenius norm of J_ij = π_i T_ij − π_j T_ji with a 95% trajectory-bootstrap CI. Intervals that reach ~0 are consistent with equilibrium-like currents on this sample. Glimmer's larger norm is an underpowered 2-trajectory cell and is not a circulation claim.
limitations: The point estimate can sit slightly outside the bootstrap interval when a few trajectories dominate J. ‖J‖ is a scalar summary of a K×K matrix. Instruct-under-P1; almost every frame is degenerate.
